svg.title: ShopLedger — architecture and complete order placement flow
svg.desc: Source-verified architecture: four Express routers, ten core modules, plain JavaScript UI, configuration, JSON persistence, and eight numbered stages of order creation. Named target arrows list every local module dependency without crossing connectors.
svg.text: Source-verified onboarding map · Node.js / Express monolith · browser UI · local JSON database
One process • direct calls • no service bus
public/index.html + public/js/app.js + public/css/style.css · shared globals and DOM updates; no frontend framework
bodyParser.json() → express.static(public) → app.use("/api", each router) · app.listen(config.port) when run directly
GET /orders/:id/invoice → store.read() → orders.get(db, id) → invoice.render(order) → HTML (404 if missing)
Direct dependencies → config.js; lib/store.js, orders.js, invoice.js; all four route files. No authentication middleware. [server.js:5–37]
03 ROUTERS — actual HTTP contracts and direct library calls
Catalog, sellable stock, GST, coupon list
04 CORE MODULES — every lib/ module; arrow references identify exact dependency targets
Names after → refer to lib/<name>.js unless explicitly qualified. Pure helpers and mutations receive data from callers; only store touches the file.
Discount allocation; HSN tax; rounded totals
Checks active flag, minimum, discount cap
Only module performing database file I/O
config.js:1–84; consumer imports and value accesses
products[]: id, SKU, HSN, price, stock, reserved
customers[]: credit limit, billed, settled, balance
orders[]: customerId, item snapshots, totals, status
All routers + server invoice handler call store.read().
store.js:4–37 · complete synchronous JSON rewrite; audit capped at 100
Gray connector = request, response, call or mount
→ Named target = confirmed direct dependency / call
Blue: browser / entry point Purple: routers
Teal: persistent data Amber numbered cards: order flow
No queue, worker, webhook or payment gateway in this flow.
Cash / UPI are recorded modes; no payment verification.
PDF is commented out; admin reset is only a comment.
No pending → completed endpoint found. Deployment unknown.
07 ORDER PLACEMENT FLOW — synchronous execution, left → right, then right → left
Numbered stages are calls inside existing files, not additional services. Backend errors stop before store.write(); no background task follows success.
Server copies price / SKU / HSN / name.
Clear cart; show ID, total, invoice link.
History GET shows stored status; no push.
Stored: stock, order, optional khata debit.
Pending orders also deduct stock / khata.
Failure responses: 400 empty/unknown item, invalid coupon or missing khata account; 409 stock / khata failure → UI error. XHR has no network-error callback.
Invoice branch: open /orders/:id/invoice → server.js:25–29 → store.read → orders.get → invoice.render. Recalculates money independently; may differ from order total.
Evidence labels use repository-relative file:line locations. All arrows confirmed from imports, route registration or function calls; no hypothetical infrastructure shown.
